answer: I stake the epoch on Cartwright iron tyre warrant sworn before the tyre forge bench. The stake is real because each iron tyre is a year of wheelwright logs in the spoke ledger, so a farm must takes years, not minutes. The cost lands per alias, not per farm: 754 aliases, 754 proofs, 89726 POA, 12818 minutes, no shortcuts. One crystal proves the identity, one knoll prices the forgery, and one sparrow records the verdict for the next epoch. A farm that pays for a hundred proofs has already lost the epoch.
